title: Microsoft Brings Quantum-Resistant Protection to Cloud Connections

sources.name: Microsoft — Post Quantum Crypto Tech Blog
sources.title: Azure Front Door now Supports Post-Quantum Resilient Hybrid TLS 1.3

sources.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
sources.title: NIST Report Provides Guidelines for Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards

sources.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
sources.title: NIST Releases First 3 Finalized Post-Quantum Encryption Standards

paragraphs.en: On November 6, 2026, Microsoft announced
paragraphs.zh: 2026年11月6日，微軟宣布，

paragraphs.en: that Azure Front Door now supports
paragraphs.zh: Azure Front Door現已支援

paragraphs.en: a new form of protection against future quantum threats.
paragraphs.zh: 一種針對未來量子威脅的新防護方式。

paragraphs.en: The update concerns TLS 1.3,
paragraphs.zh: 這項更新涉及TLS 1.3，

paragraphs.en: a technology used to secure internet connections.
paragraphs.zh: 這是一種用來保護網際網路連線的技術。

paragraphs.en: Front Door sits between users and cloud applications,
paragraphs.zh: Front Door位於使用者與雲端應用程式之間，

paragraphs.en: making it an important place to introduce stronger protection.
paragraphs.zh: 因此是導入更強防護的重要環節。

paragraphs.en: The concern extends beyond attacks happening today.
paragraphs.zh: 這項考量不只涉及今天發生的攻擊。

paragraphs.en: Attackers could collect encrypted information now
paragraphs.zh: 攻擊者可能現在先蒐集加密資訊，

paragraphs.en: and keep it until more powerful machines
paragraphs.zh: 並保存到運算能力更強的機器

paragraphs.en: can unlock it in the future.
paragraphs.zh: 未來有能力解開它的時候。

paragraphs.en: In an October 27 report announcement,
paragraphs.zh: 在10月27日的報告公告中，

paragraphs.en: the US National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
paragraphs.zh: 美國國家標準暨技術研究院（NIST）

paragraphs.en: explained this risk.
paragraphs.zh: 說明了這項風險。

paragraphs.en: Information that must remain private for many years
paragraphs.zh: 必須保密多年的資訊，

paragraphs.en: could be especially exposed to this delayed threat.
paragraphs.zh: 可能特別容易受到這類延後發動的威脅影響。

paragraphs.en: Encryption protects information through difficult mathematical problems.
paragraphs.zh: 加密透過難解的數學問題來保護資訊。

paragraphs.en: Ordinary computers cannot easily solve the problems
paragraphs.zh: 一般電腦無法輕易解開這些問題，

paragraphs.en: behind many current methods.
paragraphs.zh: 而這些問題正是許多現有方法的基礎。

paragraphs.en: A sufficiently powerful quantum computer could change that.
paragraphs.zh: 運算能力足夠強的量子電腦，可能改變這個情況。

paragraphs.en: NIST published its first three completed post-quantum standards
paragraphs.zh: NIST發布了首批三項正式後量子標準，

paragraphs.en: on August 13, 2024.
paragraphs.zh: 日期為2024年8月13日。

paragraphs.en: These use different mathematical problems
paragraphs.zh: 這些標準運用不同的數學問題，

paragraphs.en: chosen to resist attacks by both kinds of computer.
paragraphs.zh: 經過挑選，目的是抵禦這兩類電腦的攻擊。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft's new approach combines an established method
paragraphs.zh: 微軟的新做法結合了一種既有方法

paragraphs.en: with a method from the newer standards.
paragraphs.zh: 及一種來自新標準的方法。

paragraphs.en: This combination is called hybrid key establishment.
paragraphs.zh: 這種組合稱為混合式金鑰建立。

paragraphs.en: It helps two systems agree on a shared secret
paragraphs.zh: 它幫助兩個系統協調出共同祕密，

paragraphs.en: used to protect their communication.
paragraphs.zh: 用來保護彼此的通訊。

paragraphs.en: According to Microsoft, the combination remains secure
paragraphs.zh: 根據微軟的說明，這種組合仍能維持安全，

paragraphs.en: if either component remains secure.
paragraphs.zh: 只要其中任一組成部分仍然安全即可。

paragraphs.en: This offers protection while retaining established technology.
paragraphs.zh: 這能在保留既有技術的同時提供防護。

paragraphs.en: The coverage has an important boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 這項防護範圍有一個重要界線。

paragraphs.en: The company says the update currently protects
paragraphs.zh: 微軟表示，這次更新目前保護的是

paragraphs.en: the connection from a compatible client to Front Door.
paragraphs.zh: 相容用戶端與Front Door之間的連線。

paragraphs.en: Front Door then uses a separate connection
paragraphs.zh: 接著，Front Door使用另一條獨立連線，

paragraphs.en: to reach services behind it.
paragraphs.zh: 連接後端服務。

paragraphs.en: Extending the new protection to those connections
paragraphs.zh: 將新防護延伸至那些連線，

paragraphs.en: is a later engineering phase.
paragraphs.zh: 屬於後續的工程階段。

paragraphs.en: Older clients can use supported conventional methods,
paragraphs.zh: 較舊的用戶端可以使用受支援的傳統方法，

paragraphs.en: so compatibility remains part of the design.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，相容性仍是設計的一部分。

paragraphs.en: NIST's October report describes the broader migration challenge.
paragraphs.zh: NIST的10月報告說明了更廣泛的轉換挑戰。

paragraphs.en: Organisations have different systems, suppliers and uses for encryption.
paragraphs.zh: 各組織有不同的系統、供應商及加密用途。

paragraphs.en: Their entire supply chain can affect the transition.
paragraphs.zh: 整個供應鏈都可能影響轉換過程。

paragraphs.en: Combining older and newer methods is one option,
paragraphs.zh: 結合新舊方法是一種選項，

paragraphs.en: but it can require additional computing resources.
paragraphs.zh: 但可能需要額外的運算資源。

paragraphs.en: A clear schedule helps organisations plan
paragraphs.zh: 明確的時程能幫助各組織規劃，

paragraphs.en: which technologies to replace and when.
paragraphs.zh: 決定哪些技術需要更換，以及何時更換。

paragraphs.en: The standards also address more than one task.
paragraphs.zh: 這些標準處理的任務也不只一種。

paragraphs.en: Some protect information exchanged across a network,
paragraphs.zh: 有些保護透過網路交換的資訊，

paragraphs.en: while others support digital signatures used to check identity.
paragraphs.zh: 另一些則支援用來驗證身分的數位簽章。

paragraphs.en: These tasks serve different purposes.
paragraphs.zh: 這些任務各有不同目的。

paragraphs.en: The distinction helps explain why a change
paragraphs.zh: 這項區別有助於說明，為何針對

paragraphs.en: in connection security is one part
paragraphs.zh: 連線安全所做的改變，只是其中一部分，

paragraphs.en: of a much wider technical effort.
paragraphs.zh: 而整體技術工作涉及的範圍更廣。

paragraphs.en: For the technology industry, these announcements illustrate
paragraphs.zh: 對科技業而言，這些公告呈現了

paragraphs.en: a gradual transition from standards to practical services.
paragraphs.zh: 從標準走向實際服務的漸進轉換。

paragraphs.en: New protection must work with existing software
paragraphs.zh: 新防護必須與現有軟體協同運作，

paragraphs.en: and fit into connected systems.
paragraphs.zh: 並融入相互連接的系統。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft's update provides a concrete example of that process.
paragraphs.zh: 微軟的更新提供了這個過程的具體例子。

paragraphs.en: Its stated limits also show why
paragraphs.zh: 它所說明的限制也解釋了，

paragraphs.en: the exact scope of each improvement matters.
paragraphs.zh: 為何每項改善的確切範圍都很重要。

across.meaning: 跨越、透過；across a network指透過網路

agree.meaning: 達成共識；agree on指協調出共同採用的事物

an.meaning: 一個、一種；母音發音前的不定冠詞

be.meaning: 是；與過去分詞連用可構成被動語態

behind.meaning: 在…後端；也指構成某方法的基礎

both.meaning: 兩者都；both A and B指A與B兩者

broader.meaning: 範圍更廣的、更大規模的

client.meaning: 用戶端；連線至服務的程式或裝置

clients.meaning: 用戶端（複數）；連線至服務的程式或裝置

coverage.meaning: 涵蓋範圍；文中指防護範圍

door.meaning: 門；Front Door為微軟雲端服務名稱的一部分

establishment.meaning: 建立；key establishment指建立共同祕密金鑰的過程

fit.meaning: 融入、配合；fit into指融入某環境

for.meaning: 為了、對於；for example指舉例來說

front.meaning: 前面的；Front Door為微軟雲端服務名稱的一部分

hybrid.meaning: 混合式的；文中指結合傳統與後量子方法

in.meaning: 在某時間、領域或範圍中

institute.meaning: 研究院；文中為NIST全名的一部分

is.meaning: 是；也可作被動或進行式的助動詞

it.meaning: 它；文中指資訊、Front Door或某方法

migration.meaning: 轉換、遷移；文中指換用新的密碼技術

more.meaning: 更多的；更；more than指不只是

nist's.meaning: 美國國家標準暨技術研究院的

of.meaning: …的；表示所屬、性質、內容等關係

offers.meaning: 提出願意給予或幫忙；也指提供

others.meaning: 其他的；文中指其他標準

plan.meaning: 計畫（名詞）；計畫、打算（動詞）

post-quantum.meaning: 後量子的；指為抵禦未來量子電腦攻擊而設計的密碼技術

powerful.meaning: 能力強大的；文中指運算能力強

quantum.meaning: 量子的；quantum computer指量子電腦

remain.meaning: 保持；remain private指維持私密狀態

secret.meaning: 祕密；文中指雙方共用以保護通訊的祕密資訊

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the article?

choices.text: To announce that every cloud connection is now protected by post-quantum methods.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段明確指出，目前只涵蓋相容用戶端與Front Door之間的連線。

choices.text: To explain a new cloud security update within the wider transition to post-quantum protection.
choices.explanation: 正確。文章介紹微軟的新防護、適用界線及整體標準轉換背景。

choices.text: To show that all organisations can replace their encryption in exactly the same way.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第六段指出各組織的系統、供應商及用途不同。

choices.text: To argue that digital signatures and connection protection perform the same task.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七段強調兩者的用途不同。

quiz.explanation: 全文從微軟11月6日的更新出發，說明量子風險、混合式方法、防護範圍，以及更廣泛的轉換工作。因此主旨是把新服務更新放進後量子防護的轉型背景中理解。

evidence.quote: On November 6, 2026, Microsoft announced that Azure Front Door now supports a new form of protection against future quantum threats.
For the technology industry, these announcements illustrate a gradual transition from standards to practical services.

quiz.question: Why might information collected today remain at risk in the future?

choices.text: All existing encryption methods can already be broken by any ordinary computer.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段指出一般電腦不容易解開許多現有加密方法所依據的數學問題。

choices.text: Digital signatures automatically reveal the contents of stored messages.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章只說數位簽章用於驗證身分，沒有說會洩露訊息內容。

choices.text: A more powerful future machine could unlock encrypted information that attackers have saved.
choices.explanation: 正確。第二段說明攻擊者可能先蒐集、保存加密資訊，再等未來有能力的機器解開。

choices.text: Cloud suppliers are required to publish all private information after several years.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。正文沒有這種規定，也沒有將風險歸因於供應商必須公開資料。

quiz.explanation: 風險來自時間差：資訊現在即使是加密狀態，仍可能被先行保存，等未來技術進步後再嘗試解密，尤其影響需要長期保密的資訊。

evidence.quote: Attackers could collect encrypted information now and keep it until more powerful machines can unlock it in the future.

quiz.question: Which conclusion about the update is best supported by the article?

choices.text: It is a step in a wider transition, with further work needed on other connections.
choices.explanation: 正確。第五段說後端連線防護屬於後續階段，第六段交代整體轉換涉及不同系統與供應鏈。

choices.text: It removes the need for any conventional method on older clients.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段指出較舊用戶端仍可使用受支援的傳統方法。

choices.text: It has already extended the new protection to every service behind Front Door.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段明確表示延伸至後端連線是後續工程階段。

choices.text: It proves that encryption no longer requires computing resources.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第六段指出結合新舊方法可能需要額外運算資源。

quiz.explanation: 更新有明確的現階段邊界，不能把用戶端至Front Door的防護，直接視為全部後端連線也已完成轉換。整體轉型仍涉及供應鏈及後續工程工作。

evidence.quote: Extending the new protection to those connections is a later engineering phase.
Their entire supply chain can affect the transition.
